name: Agent Workflow Canvas
thesis: Enterprise AI should make uncertainty, authority, and recovery visible before an agent takes consequential action.
productDecisions: Show the workflow and execution trace in the same product surface.
Treat human approval as a stateful policy boundary, not a confirmation modal.
Invalidate progress after a permission failure and make recovery explicit.
Use deterministic synthetic scenarios so every state is inspectable.

scenarios.outcome: failed closed, then recovered with scoped access

ipBoundary: Original demonstration code only; no employer code, customer data, production credentials, private prompts, or proprietary automation logic.
